plot-title: The coordinate swap against the text swap
plot-caption: Mean change of c_yes_i from the clean prompt, paired over 100 images, 95% CI. The bar marks the effect of the text swap on the same images. swap: the lens coordinates of Manhattan and Bronx. swap_logit: the same with the rows of the unembedding. null: the name against an unrelated noun. random: a pair of random vectors.
